title: VESPER municipal sign atlas
prompt: Original BELMONDO VESPER CIRCUIT artwork: dark sci-fi neon metropolis, dense vertical inhabited urban canyon and rooftop anti-gravity raceway. Original PS1 visual language, fog, wet-looking surfaces, striking silhouettes and readable lane cues. Mood reference only, no IP copying. Design a flat graphic texture atlas with four bold original fictional municipal/transit neon signs on dark navy, cyan and warm amber, no recognizable logos or franchise imagery. Signs: VESPER, NIGHT MARKET, ROOF TRANSIT, EAST STACK. No photographic mockup, no perspective, large readable typography and geometric wayfinding marks. 2 by 2 atlas, square artwork.
